ice_registry_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the IceGrid registry host.

ice_registry_port.description: TCP port for the IceGrid registry locator.

ice_registry_ssl_port.description: SSL port for the IceGrid registry locator (used if SSL locator is enabled).

ice_grid_node_name.description: Unique name for this IceGrid node within the deployment.

ice_grid_node_bind_host.description: Host or IP address the node object adapter binds to.

ice_grid_node_data_dir.description: Directory where the IceGrid node maintains its data.

ice_grid_node_output_dir.description: Directory where server stdout and stderr are redirected.

ice_use_systemd_journal.description: Whether to use systemd journal for logging.
